evidence.summary: Run in the foreground. tsc --noEmit and vite build finished with exit 0 (build ~1s). The log has no error or warning lines.

Read the three unit files. exportReport() posts to /api/diagnoses/:id/report with no body; httpClient.post sends `{}` as JSON for body-less writes (src/api/httpClient.ts). The server route (server/routes/reportRoutes.ts) is mounted in server/app.ts and returns { fileName, directory } from saveFile. The PDF button sits in ResultHeader's actions div next to CompareWithLink (ResultPage.tsx). The dialog keeps the Radix close from firing mid-save: handleOpenChange ignores close while busy, and handleSave calls event.preventDefault(), which makes Radix Close skip onOpenChange. Success shows role=status result-pdf-saved; failure shows role=alert result-pdf-error with 'Tentar de novo'.

messages.text: Deferred AC-dm-36 checks to run after all producers finish: (1) `pnpm test -- tests/unit/reportModel.test.ts tests/api/reportRoutes.test.ts`; (2) `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/report.spec.ts`, which must be created by phase 4 and should export from the result page, check the result-pdf-saved message and find the file in the injected downloadsDir; (3) in the Play dev-link, open a completed result, click Exportar PDF, then Salvar PDF, and open the saved file in <home>/Downloads to confirm every AC-dm-36 field.

ExportReportDialog.handleSave must keep its event.preventDefault() call. Radix Close skips onOpenChange when the click event is default-prevented, so removing it would close the dialog while the save is still running.
